races.paceDynamic: In The Post will take this field along as the sole confirmed front runner, setting what should be a comfortable, sustainable tempo over the extended 1m4f trip without pressure from the break. Behind him, Piecederesistance will likely track in second or third, while the bulk of the field - It's Only Fun, Sisterandbrother, Recobella, Cavalry Call and Wath Court - are all hold-up performers who will settle towards the rear. With just one pace-setter and five hold-up horses, this creates a tactical scenario that strongly favours the prominent runners and those with tactical pace, as the finish is likely to become a sprint from the back where traffic problems and positioning will be crucial.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If In The Post gets an uncontested lead and controls the fractions
scenarios.body: He can dictate terms throughout and prove difficult to peg back, while the hold-up brigade gets bunched up behind him. The lack of early pace pressure allows him to save energy for a sustained kick when the field comes to him.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Sprint Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too slow and the field bunches up turning for home
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint finish where the strongest finishers prevail, with positioning and luck in running becoming decisive factors. Traffic problems will eliminate several chances as five hold-up horses look for racing room simultaneously.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Piecederesistance gets the perfect trip tracking the leader
scenarios.body: His tactical speed advantage over the pure hold-up horses becomes decisive as he can respond to In The Post's move while the back markers are still finding their rhythm. Recent third at Ripon suggests he's in good heart for this tactical setup.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Cavalry Call Late Rally
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuinely strong and the hold-up horses get a clear run
scenarios.body: His highest TopSpeed rating of 78 could tell, though his 116-day absence and poor recent form make this unlikely. Would need everything to fall perfectly including a strong pace to set up his finishing kick.

watchPoints.text: In The Post getting an uncontested lead - if he's allowed to bowl along in front without pressure, he becomes very difficult to catch
Traffic problems in the home straight with five hold-up horses all looking for racing room simultaneously from the back of the field
Cavalry Call's fitness after 116 days off - any market support would be significant given his long absence
Piecederesistance's early positioning - if he can sit second or third rather than getting shuffled back, his tactical speed becomes crucial
The pace through the middle stages - if it becomes too steady, it sets up a pure sprint finish that eliminates several chances

races.paceDynamic: Lorna B is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate proceedings from the gates, likely setting a comfortable early gallop without pressure from the prominent runners Men Of Honour, HK Fourteen and Cairdeas who prefer to track rather than challenge immediately. The large contingent of hold-up horses including Coachello, Lord Bertie, Novello Lad, Supreme King, Gallant, Havana Rum, Wreck It Ryley and Noble Consort will create a bunched field behind the early leader. With minimal early pace pressure and a strong finishing kick expected from multiple hold-up specialists, this race shape clearly favours closers who can produce late speed over the final two furlongs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Lorna B sets uncontested fractions and the field remains bunched turning for home.
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows closers to conserve energy before unleashing finishing kicks, with multiple hold-up horses converging late. This tactical setup perfectly suits the patient riding styles and turn-of-foot profiles.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Men Of Honour or HK Fourteen position perfectly behind Lorna B and kick before the hold-up brigade.
scenarios.body: The prominent runners get first run on the closers while avoiding the early pace battle, timing their move to perfection before the field can respond. Their tactical advantage proves decisive in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Lorna B sets crawling fractions and the race becomes a pure sprint finish.
scenarios.body: The lack of any meaningful pace turns this into a dash from the three-furlong pole with raw speed mattering most. Those with the highest turn of foot benefit regardless of running style when bunched at the business end.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Leader Steals Division
scenarios.trigger: If Lorna B faces no meaningful challenge and maintains her advantage throughout.
scenarios.body: The front runner capitalises on the lack of early pace pressure to build an unassailable lead while the hold-up horses leave their runs too late. Her unchallenged position proves insurmountable despite the closing surge.

watchPoints.text: Lorna B setting unsustainably fast early fractions could compromise her stamina reserves and open the door for closers.
Men Of Honour's fitness after 208-day absence may be questionable despite Ruth Carr's stable returning to form.
Supreme King and Havana Rum both stepping up significantly in class from recent easier victories.
Multiple hold-up horses potentially getting in each other's way if they all produce runs simultaneously in the final furlong.
Weather conditions affecting the going description before racing as consistent good ground favours several runners.

races.paceDynamic: Watchdog will lead from the gates as the only confirmed front-runner, likely setting a controlled tempo without early pressure. The real congestion sits behind him where Orange Emperor, Milford Grange, Believeinmenow and Black Endeavour all want prominent positions - creating traffic issues turning for home. Six horses prefer to be held up (Concert, Slot, Uncertainty, Wise Crack, Coyy) which suggests a strong late charge scenario with runners fanning wide 2f out. This race shape strongly favours the hold-up horses who can avoid the prominent traffic and benefit from the solid pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Brigade Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent quartet causes traffic problems turning in while Watchdog maintains his lead
scenarios.body: The six hold-up horses get clean runs on the outside while the prominent runners get shuffled back in the melee. Fresh finishers pick off a tiring Watchdog in the final furlong.

scenarios.title: Watchdog Wires Field
scenarios.trigger: If Watchdog gets soft fractions early and the prominent pack fails to apply pressure
scenarios.body: The leader maintains his advantage through controlled sectionals while the hold-up horses leave their runs too late. Watchdog's recent winning form at the trip proves decisive under minimal pressure.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Runner Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one horse breaks clear from the prominent pack to challenge Watchdog 3f out
scenarios.body: Orange Emperor or Believeinmenow gets first run on the leader while avoiding the worst of the traffic behind. The early move catches the hold-up horses napping and sustains to the line.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Carnage
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses early and the field bunches into a sprint finish
scenarios.body: Watchdog goes too slow early allowing the entire field to close up entering the final 2f. The race becomes a cavalry charge where positioning and luck determine the outcome more than ability.

races.paceDynamic: Masaban and Ice Cube will set honest fractions from the start, with both confirmed front-runners likely to dispute the early lead over this flat Doncaster mile. Their presence should create a strong gallop that will stretch the field, particularly with several prominent racers like High Chieftain, Irish Incentive, and Smartanck tracking close behind. The sustained pace will test stamina reserves in the final two furlongs, setting up a finish where those held up can time their runs effectively. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can finish fast, as the early pace battle should compromise the leaders and create opportunities for late closers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Thrive
scenarios.trigger: If Masaban and Ice Cube engage in a pace duel from the start
scenarios.body: The strong early gallop will set up perfectly for closers like Tarmonbarry Kid, Crimson Sunset, and Red Rifle who can pick off tired leaders. The sustained pace over this flat track should create ideal conditions for patient tactics to prevail.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is strong but one tracker avoids the battle
scenarios.body: High Chieftain or Irish Incentive can sit handy without getting involved in the early pace war, then strike when the leaders weaken. Their tactical position allows them to benefit from the pace while conserving energy for a winning move.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of Masaban or Ice Cube can steal a march and dictate terms
scenarios.body: The winner gets first run and holds off late challenges through superior early positioning and tactical speed. Ice Cube's recent improved form suggests he could be the one to make all or take over smoothly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Moderate Pace Suits All
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders show restraint and create a tactical affair
scenarios.body: Without genuine pace pressure, this becomes more about raw ability than tactics, potentially suiting progressive sorts. The race could develop into a sprint finish where any running style can prevail.

races.paceDynamic: Dion Baker holds a monopoly on early pace with most rivals preferring to sit off the tempo. The lone leader will dictate proceedings unchallenged through moderate fractions, creating a tactical advantage that could prove decisive. With 15 of 18 runners adopting hold-up or midfield tactics, this becomes a waiting game behind an uncontested leader. This race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can track the pace closely, while the hold-up brigade face a difficult task overcoming a sustainable tempo.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Dion Baker maintains a steady gallop without pressure
scenarios.body: The lone pace-setter controls the race completely and has enough left to resist late challenges. Hold-up horses struggle to make up the ground against a horse that hasn't been asked serious questions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners position perfectly behind Dion Baker
scenarios.body: Heretic, Bullington Bry and Back From Dubai sit in the ideal stalking positions and have the tactical edge when the pace quickens. They get first run on the tiring leader while the hold-up horses are still making ground.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Strong Closer Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely strong or Dion Baker stops quickly
scenarios.body: The better hold-up horses with proven finishing kicks like Moonhall Lass and Typeface benefit from a true run race. Superior class tells in the final furlong as the early leaders weaken significantly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Dion Baker goes too slow and multiple horses challenge simultaneously
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the three-furlong pole with no clear pace advantage. It becomes pure speed and class with the most in-form runners benefiting from the leveled playing field.

watchPoints.text: Monitor if any prominent runners challenge Dion Baker early as this could set up the hold-up horses perfectly

Note how aggressively the 5lb claimers ride as Bullington Bry and others could benefit from inexperienced tactics

races.paceDynamic: Lion Ring is the sole confirmed front runner in this 17-runner handicap and should get an uncontested lead through steady fractions. With most of the field carrying hold-up tactics, the pace will be moderate early before building from the 3f pole as the large pack of hold-up horses unleash simultaneously. On Key and Diligent Henry may track Lion Ring prominently but lack the early speed to pressure the leader. This race shape strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can avoid the traffic problems that will engulf the massed ranks of hold-up horses in the home straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Lion Ring leads throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Lion Ring breaks cleanly and maintains rhythm without pressure
scenarios.body: The veteran gets first run on the field and keeps finding under a patient ride from the front. The wall of hold-up horses gets caught in traffic while Lion Ring exploits his tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent tracker pounces
scenarios.trigger: If On Key or Diligent Henry track Lion Ring and time their challenge perfectly
scenarios.body: The tracker saves ground in second while Lion Ring does the donkey work, then strikes decisively in the final furlong. Hold-up horses still struggle with the pace differential and congestion.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-up horse finds gaps
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and clear runs emerge for closers
scenarios.body: War Memorial or Sedgemoor thread through traffic to deliver their finishing kicks effectively. The front runners fade after setting modest fractions that suit patient tactics.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Traffic chaos causes upset
scenarios.trigger: If multiple hold-up horses are severely hampered and an outsider gets a dream run
scenarios.body: The pace scenario remains sound but interference creates an unexpected winner from the pack. A lightly-weighted closer like Create or No Gain capitalizes on others' misfortune.
